name: Limited Jumps Obby
desc:
Welcome to LIMITED JUMPS OBBY! This game is like any normal difficulty chart obby… except you only get a limited number of jumps per stage! Only the most precise players can make it through! Can you beat the game without running out of jumps or rage quitting?

Inspired by IMPOSSIBLE OBBY & Limited Jumps! 🎉

- 🔢 100 unique, colorful, and fun stages!
- 🌟 Collect rebirth points to buy halos for your avatar!
- 📈 Rebirth to climb the leaderboards and compete against others!

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shiftlock (Shift, LT)
